goal: VALIDATION: run the new deterministic ETL stages (extract media+content, import media, MCP loader, fidelity) end-to-end against the already-deployed lesalondelaphoto module to confirm the harness additions work in the loop.

epics.title: Validate new ETL stages

stories.title: extract -> media -> load -> fidelity

steps.title: Extract media + content from source (deterministic, agnostic)
acceptance_criteria: Migration is ETL: the captured DOM is the source of truth. Run the DETERMINISTIC extractors (source_detect + extract_media + extract_content) — do NOT hand-author or improvise the manifests; they must come from the real captured source.

Media manifest (orchestration/images/<project>.json) must cover every captured page incl. home; content-load (orchestration/content/<project>.content-load.json) must hold the REAL per-page text/instances, not placeholders.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/extract.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Import media into the DAM (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Import EVERY image from the deterministic manifest (orchestration/images/<project>.json) into the DAM via orchestration/images/import.py — do not skip media. This is the 0-of-40-images fix.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/media.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Create content (Gate 4: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: LOAD content from orchestration/content/<project>.content-load.json and wire imported media from orchestration/images/<project>.imported.json — do NOT improvise text or invent placeholder content (the captured source is the source of truth).

Run the DETERMINISTIC MCP loader to create content from the extracted source: python3 orchestration/lib/load_content.py lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto --clean  — it creates each node via MCP content.create with real field values AND wires the imported image weakref at create time (lib/mcp_client.py), then publishes. Do NOT hand-write GraphQL or improvise content.

Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot do it; state any fallback in the summary.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Import via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID), set the WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo), clear any *ExternalUrl string. Canonical tools: orchestration/images/set_hero_refs.py and set_image_refs.py lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto lsp. Capture source URLs via browser (site blocks the agent).
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/mcp.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto lsp

Render-gate EACH page as you finish it (do not defer to the end). The step is not done until every page renders clean: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt

Publish completeness: every weakref'd asset (image/logo/link/category) must resolve in LIVE and every translation must be published (publish WITH languages:[fr]): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/publish-parity.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr

Editability: shared regions (nav/footer/topbar) must render AND be editable in Page Builder, not blank (AbsoluteAreas need child content nodes): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/edit-frame.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr home

Quality: every page passes a11y (axe-core, no critical/serious) + SEO baseline (title, meta, single h1, img alt): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/site-review.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt

Reuse guard: content/page discovery must NOT add types beyond the approved per-project baseline (reuse a type or add a view instead): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lsp projects/lesalondelaphoto/component-baseline.txt
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots, return status halt.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-graphql-writes.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto

steps.title: Visual diff
acceptance_criteria: Structural fidelity is a HARD gate, JS-rendered both sides: every page that has a captured reference DOM must match it on sections + listing/card counts + facet values (capture-reference must have run): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/fidelity-all.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto lesalondelaphoto fr @orchestration/sitemaps/lesalondelaphoto.txt
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/artifact.sh projects/lesalondelaphoto/workflow-output/visual-diff/SUMMARY.md "critical"
